distribution.title:
Research, Latvian participation in international TOSCANINI (TAD disruption and aberrant expression as leukemia metabolic vulnerabilities for
novel combination therapy tests in a drug screening platform) project.

security_and_privacy.description: For data access - password protected digital files. Storage planned on RSU NextCloud. Physical data transmission and sharing  protected with access control within participating institutions. Before transmission physical data will be stored in a locked cabinet at Riga East University Hospital.

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan describes how research data generated during participation in the project will be collected, documented, stored, shared, and preserved. 
The project includes collection of patient's biological material (bone marrow) and its transportation for examination within the framework of the project, and participation in data collection.
dmp.ethical_issues_description: We will be collecting personal and medical sensitive data.
